brief: A small display stand: three bases meeting at a corner with a raised platform on a spike at that corner.

requirements.evidence: Three full bases piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full and piece:0,1,0;full form a single tri-corner cluster; check_build shows them as one group

requirements.requirement: Raised platform on a spike at that corner
requirements.evidence: Mount spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 stands at the junction of the three bases, fitted with the large platform accessory (platform-lrg set via setSpikeAccessory), giving a raised flat plate above the corner

finish.summary: A small display stand: three full hexagonal bases arranged in a tri-corner cluster, with a mount spike rising from their shared corner junction and a large platform plate trapped on the spike as the raised display surface. Open faces were capped and joints locked per house rules. check_build is clear (no issues, meshClash clear). No dressing prop could be placed on the spike platform (the configurator does not offer it as a prop surface), so the platform is left empty as the parts-only stand.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Three bases at a corner with a spiked platform on top — I'll check the current build and find the base and spike sockets to lay it out.

result.note: A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
